name: @jskit-ai/resource-runtime
description: The resource runtime: features own their tables through it and read and write them with scoped handles on json-rest-api.

surfaces.summary: Provides runtime.resources (ResourceRuntimeProvider): own(featureId, owns) registers a feature's tables and answers their scoped handles, and declareSystemScope(featureId, systemScope) answers the feature's systemContext(reason) for work across every workspace and user. Exports createStandaloneResources, passedOn, withoutHiddenFields, isSystemContext, buildJsonRestQueryParams, the workspace and user scope resolvers, the default row limit and page size, and the runtime's error classes.
Types of runtime.resources, its handles, call options and system contexts.

Data test helpers on a real test database: createTestResourceRuntime, startTestFeatures, expectScoped, expectFlatQueries, expectEveryTableOwned, createPackageTestKnex, requireTestDatabase and TestDatabaseMissingError.
